info.aboutBody: Teesilm is an independent, unofficial companion to Estonia's official Tark Tee road-conditions service. It shows the same public data from the Transport Administration (Transpordiamet), in a cleaner, mobile-first map.
info.aboutBodyExtra: Built by Maris, a developer who wanted a faster way to check road conditions without digging through Tark Tee's cluttered map and coarse email alerts. It's a small personal project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Transpordiamet — if something here looks wrong, that's on this project, not them.
info.guideUsingMap1: Pinch or scroll to zoom, drag to pan.
info.guideUsingMap2: Tap any marker for details, or a numbered cluster to zoom into it.
info.guideUsingMap3: Use the layers button (bottom-left) to show or hide each category on the map.
info.guideUsingMap4: Switch between light, dark, and automatic theme with the icon in the top-right corner.
info.guideAlertsBody1: Subscribers can save locations — like home or work — and get notified about hazards, roadworks, and other alerts nearby.
info.guideAlertsBody2: To add one: open the Account tab, tap "Add location", then search for an address or drag the pin to the exact spot.
info.guideAlertsBody3: The radius slider shows exactly how far the alert area reaches, drawn live on the map. Choose which categories you want to be alerted about, from slippery roads to full closures.
info.guideAlertsBody4: Enable push notifications from the same screen to get alerts even when the app isn't open. Your browser will ask for permission the first time.
info.guideFreeVsPaidBody: Weather readings, hazards, and roadworks are free for everyone. A subscription additionally unlocks live camera images, live road sign content, weather history, and saved locations with push alerts — see the full comparison on the Account tab.
info.guideAccountBody1: One subscription works on all your devices. On a new device, open the Account tab and use "Already subscribed? Sign in on this device" to get a one-time sign-in link by email.
info.guideAccountBody2: Manage or cancel your subscription anytime from the Account tab's "Manage subscription" button.
info.guideAccountBody3: Choose which emails you receive — product updates, service announcements, billing — from the Email preferences section once you're signed in.
info.guideAccountBody4: You can permanently delete your account at any time from the "Delete account" button at the bottom of the Account tab. This removes your saved locations, push subscriptions, and email preferences, and cancels any active subscription — it can't be undone.
info.legendWeatherStationsDesc: Tap for real road/air temperature, surface condition, wind, and grip.
info.legendCamerasDesc: Tap for the camera's location. Viewing the live image is a paid feature.
info.legendHazardsDesc: Tap for details on slippery roads, accidents, roadworks, and other alerts.
info.legendRestrictionsDesc: Tap for details on closures, speed limits, and ongoing works.
info.legendVmsDesc: Tap for the sign's location. Viewing its live speed limit or warning is a paid feature.
info.legendClusters: Numbered circles are clusters of nearby markers — tap one to zoom in.
info.howTo1: Pinch or scroll to zoom, drag to pan.
info.howTo3: Tap a numbered cluster to zoom into it.
